finetune._comment: Modular head (head/feature_head FeatureHead): each features entry is {type, its own keys} and gets its own spatial filter. Types: atom_power (log power, time_pool flat|learned|window|none, time_rank, window), signed_ab (signed phase-locked: atom_rank, time_rank), latent_signed (signed_ab on the encoder output z), raw_band / raw_signal (raw-input baseline). Default: the all-atom head, atom_power (induced band power, MI) + signed_ab (signed atom gains, phase-locked / P300); the stronger head swaps signed_ab for latent_signed (signed z, latent_proj pca). Any entry may set its own spatial_k (default below).
